description: Send and read messages between machines in a fleet over a shared Telegram group, so cross-machine coordination survives a file-sync outage and humans can watch the machines talk. A synced folder stays as the fallback for oversized payloads. Triggers: "/bus", "post to the bus", "check the bus", "tell the other machines".
